thesis: The episode argues that the conventional wisdom of achieving AGI solely by scaling model parameters and pre-training data is obsolete, as frontier labs have already shifted toward human-designed post-training pipelines involving retrieval and tool use. Instead of raw intelligence, the speakers contend that the critical challenge is building programmable systems where humans can effectively specify intent, moving beyond the limitations of natural language prompts.
